user_reviews.Name: nickolaev nick
user_reviews.Description:
Unfortunately, visiting this cinema did not meet the expectations one has when purchasing a ticket. The movie “Avatar 3”, which we watched today, was supposed to start exactly at 2:00 PM and include an intermission. However, in reality, for another 20 minutes after 2:00 PM we were shown various advertisements. That alone would not have been a major issue, but the real problem was that the promised intermission never happened.

The film was supposed to run until approximately 5:37 PM, and we also expected a break as advertised. However, there was no break at all. When people realized there would be no opportunity to go to the restroom, they started standing up and walking out one after another. Instead of enjoying Avatar in 3D, I constantly had someone’s backside flashing in front of my face. It was very distracting, uncomfortable, and unpleasant.

On top of that, I had the impression that the final part of the movie was shown at an accelerated speed. The only “positive” was that they finished ten minutes earlier.

I can’t say that the theater was extremely dirty, but it definitely could have been cleaned better.

An unpleasant experience.

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Sheffield
user_reviews.Description:
This use to be my favourite cinema in Amsterdam.

I have been going since it first opened during COVID times, paying for popcorn and a drink and enjoying a film experience in a clean, state of the art cinema. I have been to nearly every cinema in Amsterdam and this is my favourite. I recommend this cinema to all my friends.

UNFORTUNATELY I will be stopping and taking my business to another cinema in Amsterdam. They started to place 15 minute breaks in any film that is over 2 hours? Why? They must believe that everyone needs a toilet break and a rest for films that are over 2 hours. Every available film session has a break included. There is no option for people who want to watch the film without interruption.

Of course I understand that they are trying to make more money at the candy bar during these breaks but this completely ruins the cinema experience for me. I will take my money to another cinema and recommend to my friends not to go.

I hope that they stop with the breaks or re-introduce normal sessions of films that are over 2 hours long.

user_reviews.Name: Katherine Scott
user_reviews.Description:
I have been going to Pathe Noord since it opened and have a Pathe Unlimited membership. Unfortunately they have recently introduced a 'Pauze' during most sessions. I can understand that with many films these days being 2+ hours, some people would require an intermission. However it seems unreasonable to not give an option to watch a film in it's entirety if we want to. If I wanted to plan a break, I would wait for the film to be made available for streaming and watch it at home. While watching 'Nuremburg' I found it jarring to have the film paused and the lights come on. If a film is designed to have an intermission, then it would be OK, but this film is not. It's disruptive to the cinema experience.
There are options to see films without the intermission at other Pathe locations in the city. But the reason I switched from my Cineville membership to a Pathe membership is because I was excited to have a quality cinema in the neighbourhood. As a working mum, it's hard to get to the cinema, an experience that I love. While I loved the Cineville pass because it meant I could support more independent/arthouse cinemas, having a cinema in such close proximity means I can see more films. I made the choice to see more films.
There is an option in the intermission to give feedback via a QR code. The QR code is not wholly visible (see photo), making it impossible to scan from your seat. There isn't enough time to get up from your seat to get closer to scan it, as the ad runs randomly for only 20-30 seconds amongst other Pathe ads. And taking a photo and trying to scan it does not work.

user_reviews.Name: Phile Young Choi
user_reviews.Description:
It's rooftop bar is a nice place to enjoy draft beer and varoius 🍕 while watching the rotating light of the Mamelles lighthouse. Pizza is baked in oven. It tastes good.

This hotel used to be a perfect place to enjoy the night view of the monument of the African Renaissance, built in 2010. Due to recent buildings surrounding the hotel, it is not possible to see it anymore.

user_reviews.Name: yfishida
user_reviews.Description: While seemingly off the beaten track, this hotel is in the right place to be quiet and tranquil, yet accessible to main roads and beyond. The rooms are simple, yet adequate (and for the price). The rooftop bar/pizza is the best ... and with a view of the famous lighthouse (which is reachable by foot). And while the public areas are simple, they are comfortable and cozy that makes sitting around just a good thing, too.

user_reviews.Name: Marloes020
user_reviews.Description: It's a very nice place to stay a few night in Dakar, comfortable rooms equipped with all essentials. Friendly staff.||Breakfast is not included, but you can order it in the patio. Good start of the day.||||However, the best asset of the hotel is the rooftop terrace and bar. Great atmosphere!

user_reviews.Name: _Domitilla6_
user_reviews.Description: Visited my sister in Dakar and we went several times to the upstairs bar/dining area as there was the football European Championship and Hôtel Du Phare offers big screens to watch it. ||||I was not a guest at the hotel, so I cannot comment on the rooms, but I can say the terrace is lovely and the service is also okay. We had both pizza and burgers and both were good - pizza was a surprise, and I'm Italian. The terrace is a nice space for parties, for dinners and also for a nice evening with friends enjoying a few drinks.||||We also managed to catch one evening where they were showing a movie and that was nice - around 15/20 seats and the volume/quality was goood.||||When in Dakar I will be back.

user_reviews.Name: Emma Timmins
user_reviews.Description: What did I just pay for??? Who made this budget hotel cost so much?? The only thing this place has going for it is a nice (rich) neighbourhood and a good pizza oven. The rooms are very basic, the hot water in the bathroom doesn’t work, the breakfast is pitiful and overpriced (2,000 CFA for bread and butter??), and the rooftop terrace it boasts about is totally overrated. The view is mediocre, the place is crowded and very noisy at night, and covered with the previous evening’s garbage in the morning. The pictures online might look nice, but this hotel feels like just an afterthought- just something to do with the space under the rooftop bar. They should lower the prices to match the service/accommodation, then I wouldn’t be disappointed. One thing I will say in praise- they seem to have the fastest wifi in all of west Africa, so thanks for that.

user_reviews.Name: Gwen Robson
user_reviews.Description: Affordable hotel in Dakar with great roof-top bar location. The rooms were basic but clean. Located on dirt road behind the mini-car stop at round point Mamelles, about 400-500 meters. Recommended to call for reservations, but walk-ins don't seem like an issue unless you want a particular room. We opted for the shared bathroom and it was clean and not an issue. Would have no problem doing this again.

title: The Movies
description: Veteran art house movie theater with an Art Deco interior, a buzzing restaurant & screening rooms.

user_reviews.Name: Ana Isabel Estevez Alonso
user_reviews.Description: I was truly happy to return to 'The Movies' after all the time that it needed to be closed.  The magic created in the welcoming entrance and cafeteria merge the old one with the also exquisite new one... the 'zaal' where I watched the movie its so elegantly red.  The sound is incredible good. And I can't wait to go again and see the other rooms... Welldone guys, and best wishes for this expected return...

user_reviews.Name: Be .Franklt
user_reviews.Description: This atmosphere is simply irresistible. I'm ever so glad they've reopened. I used to come here often when I was little.

user_reviews.Name: Ил Юшка
user_reviews.Description:
A wonderful place, been there many times and it is always an engaging experience.
I also like how it is hidden in plain sight, doesn’t look that big from the street.

user_reviews.Name: Robin Irwin
user_reviews.Description:
The first cinema in Amsterdam built in 1912 in and resides in a 17th century building. This art deco styled cinema has usually one or 2 mainstream movies with a larger focus on European made movies.

There is a bar, restaurant and friendly staff that gladly help you with any questions. The cinema rooms can occupy a limited amount of people and it contains comfortable, cosy chairs and beautiful walls. It is quite the experience!

Twice a month on a Sunday there is a movie gathering of some sorts that also include snacks and drinks. So be aware that it might be packed on a Sunday. It might surprise you if you are looking for a relaxed experience on a Sunday morning.

user_reviews.Name: Aimée
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful movie theater. I believe one of the oldest of Amsterdam still remaining. I really loved the art deco aesthetic inside with the wooden furniture, the lamps and the patterned carpet. The place has a lot of character. The movie room was also beautiful with patterned wall tapestries and classic red chairs. Would definitely recommend, also to just get a drink and enjoy the sitting area.

user_reviews.Name: Halit ER
user_reviews.Description: Comparing the others in centrum, really big, fresh airy and comfortable, wide seats. And warm lobby

user_reviews.Name: Sander Hoogendoorn
user_reviews.Description: Recently re-opened arthouse cinema. Nicely kept in old-style. Good place to go see a movie and drink a beer. Same menu as Filmhallen (which is logical).

user_reviews.Name: Alexandra D
user_reviews.Description: Perfect place for a girly night out. Great vibes, kind staff, clean area.

title: COPACABANA SURF VILLAGE
address: QG33+QGF COPACABANA SURF VILLAGE, Dakar, Senegal

user_reviews.Name: dian _fatima
user_reviews.Description: I stumbled upon this gem in Dakar, Senegal, initially just for food, but ended up discovering a whole surf village! I took surfing lessons here for the first time, and it was an incredible experience. The service is outstanding, the staff is super friendly, and the surf instructors are passionate and talented. Whether you're a seasoned surfer or a beginner like me, this place should definitely be on your itinerary when visiting Senegal. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Sara Y
user_reviews.Description: Good service, nice place,  good spot.. I didn't try the food there so I can't advice on that.. but the sunset from there is what got me 😊

user_reviews.Name: Taeyoung Kim
user_reviews.Description: Very cozy and yet lively place. Just be careful when you sit outside, merchants will endlessly come and try to sell their stuff but it was quite manageable though I think. Good starting point to surf and many people enjoyed playing football, kites and badminton like sports.

user_reviews.Name: Arabang Dingalo
user_reviews.Description: Copacabana is THE spot in Dakar! Relax, read a book or meet a friend, watch the surfers and the waves (or take a surf class!), Copa is so relaxing and refreshing. The poulet was so delicious and the service was wonderful. It’s definitely going to be my staple every time I’m in Dakar. They also have blankets when it gets a little chilly at sunset.

user_reviews.Name: Omomone Iris lesly
user_reviews.Description: The place is nice and the prices are quiet affordable for a dinner , the view on the beach is just amazing, would recommend this place for people who want to spend some family’s time

user_reviews.Name: Leon Hady
user_reviews.Description:
Yeah, this has a lithe but if beach in front of it which seemed excellent for surf. Reasonably priced burgers for catching late lunch and hawkers seem to have caught surfer vibes and we’re too laid back to really hassle.

Real range of people, older surfers, backpapers, a few locals and service and food were good.

user_reviews.Name: Janette Nimmo
user_reviews.Description: Great place to watch the surfers. The food is great but the toilets aren't very good. Don't always flush or have seats but the food & view is amazing & very cheap priced.

user_reviews.Name: Saskia Holman
user_reviews.Description: Super cute spot to sit and have brunch on a Saturday. Lots of family and kids all around. Food was super tasty.

user_reviews.Name: Lin Ux
user_reviews.Description: Loud music during an afternoon visit. Difficult to have a conversation. Helpful staff.

user_reviews.Name: Abayomi Odusi
user_reviews.Description: It’s a place with a bit of loud music and very spacious, with different options of seating areas (both indoor & outdoor) depending on your preference. Good prices and opens till very early in the morning so if you’re looking for a place you can chill a little longer asides being in a packed dance club along the corniche, here is the place

user_reviews.Name: aurelly legras
user_reviews.Description:
Great spot in Dakar for a pool and lunch/supper! Service a bit slow but food was overall good.

Recommend for a morning or afternoon day

user_reviews.Name: Bertha Kibona
user_reviews.Description: The beach club is impressive, with beautiful views that made us really happy when we got there. But the service is really slow. You will see staff going up and down and wonder who they are helping when you have been waiting to be served. That was the only turnoff

user_reviews.Name: Ani Gomez
user_reviews.Description: Horrible place and the service Is horrible, they didnt let us pay  with card and it was all a mess

user_reviews.Name: Tomás Aimé Drouin
user_reviews.Description: This is my favorite spot in Dakar! Great place to swim, eat, drink, or simply relax. Sunset is spectacular and staff is super sweet. Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: Dkellz Carayol
user_reviews.Description: Chill atmosphere second time coming here and always a pleasure to be at

user_reviews.Name: John Kaninda
user_reviews.Description: Great - though noisy - place to chill in Dakar. Beautiful set up and outside terrace opposite the beach with panoramic view of the shore, the Renaissance memorial and the lighthouse of Mamelles. Wide range of French wines will make your palate happy. I didn't dare taste the cocktails. I'd definitely recommend this place.

title: Bahia Beach Club
address: PFRH+C7Q Bahia Beach Club, Dakar, Senegal

user_reviews.Name: Erik den Ouden
user_reviews.Description:
Arrived in Dakar today, first time in Senegal!We liked this place a lot. Had an apero, tapas and some drinks. Great view over the ocean and comfy seats!
If you’re not in a rush (service takes a while); it’s a nice place..

user_reviews.Name: Fabie “Fatou Bintou” Kamara
user_reviews.Description: We loved the place, it was super beautiful the food was good, during vacations a lot of people come which is probably why the wait could be a little disturbing but it’s sooooo worth it ! Would recommend 100%

user_reviews.Name: Enyinnaya Okwulehie
user_reviews.Description: ABYSMAL service and drinks are sub par. The waiting staff is disrespectful, PLEASE do not waste your time. Other than looking good, there is nothing good about this place.

user_reviews.Name: Akidah Ndoye
user_reviews.Description: I've been multiple times, if you prefer a calm vibe go during the day and night the scene shifts to a younger crowd but the food is amazing.

user_reviews.Name: FATOUMATA SAMBOU
user_reviews.Description: The worst customer service ever! The waitress was so rude. My husband and I had to cancel after taking my drink due to the rudeness of the waitress.

user_reviews.Name: Wendy
user_reviews.Description:
I've been twice now, and welcome this lovely new addition to the many restaurants on the Petite Corniche in Almadies, I think the manager has listened to a few of the early reviews, our server was fast and efficient, we started with Passionfruit frozen cocktails which were a real treat, my friend had the Menu of the day, which was lamb and I had a Caesar Salad which was a little dry but soon rectified with a dressing that was requested and soon brought to the table.
I imagine this place is popular in the evening, but for Brunch or Lunch it's a lovely breezy spot on a hot summers day!

user_reviews.Name: Saif Samm
user_reviews.Description:
Good ambiance with good food yes sometimes service can be slow because its always crowded
So its normal
Other then that its one of the best beach restaurants to come with your loved once

user_reviews.Name: Juste TOFFA
user_reviews.Description: Very good

user_reviews.Name: Hirut Sisay
user_reviews.Description:
Nice view

But limited menu option and not  ideal for family with kids (no kids meal option and smoking everywhere)

user_reviews.Name: Senegalese Baddie
user_reviews.Description:
Si y’avait moins que 1 j’allais mettre
Cadre magnifique rien à dire d’ailleurs je vous donne une étoile mais le service proposé pour le prix du GRAND N’IMPORTE QUOI
J’y étais pour le ramadan passé
Mais ce qu’il propose ??
Qlq beignets ici et deux croissants par là
Du café au lait, qlq salés c’était ahurissant pour le prix de deux on aurait pu avoir un festin à la maison
Bref je répète plus jamais 👎

user_reviews.Name: ed sorel
user_reviews.Description: Nous avons dîné et passé une excellente soirée au Cosmo. Le serveur a été attentif et aux petits soins. Le repas très bon, la carte contenue propose viandes et poissons. Mention spéciale à la souris d'agneau exceptionnelle. Merci a Sonia également qui nous a vraiment mis à l'aise.

user_reviews.Name: Nia Tra.Santucci
user_reviews.Description:
Bel accueil. De beaux aménagements.
Les plats sont bons et le personnel aux petits soins.

user_reviews.Name: Clara Nigaghossian
user_reviews.Description:
Super coin de paradis la journée
Un peu difficile à trouver à cause des travaux mais ça vaut le coup !

user_reviews.Name: Maria Camara
user_reviews.Description: Attendre 40 bonne minutes pour une salade Caesar.. le cadre est jolie mais plus pour boire un verre , la piscine est bien mais il n’y a pas de transat

user_reviews.Name: mame ibrahima camara
user_reviews.Description: C’est vraiment un des meilleurs Lounge de tout Dakar, venez nombreux la famille y’a tout ce que vous désirez, bouffe drink sons et lumière avec une bonne ambiance ne vous le faites pas raconter

user_reviews.Name: Martin Philip
user_reviews.Description: Le personnel est très insolent. ÉVITEZ!!!

user_reviews.Name: Vicky Stephens
user_reviews.Description: The rice and plantain were delicious.  the cocktail was also lovely. the service was a bit weird...it could be better.

user_reviews.Name: HAVADAN SUDAN İŞLER
user_reviews.Description: This restaurant was nice and otantic place. There is no need to make a reservation, you can find a suitable table to eat lunch or dinner.. But, I advise to you lunch instead of dinner.. Because, at night hours it is impossible to see anything around while eating your meal. Very dark seaside.. only you may hear the sounds of waves that angrily hitting to stones on the beach..! It is possible to find every kind of meals..For example; sea foods, chicken, vegetables, meat, also t-bone.. We eat mixed seafood brewer.. Not so good, not so bad. Average..! Prices were normal.. maximum 15-20 $ for one person ok.. If you are looking for luxery, this place is not for you.. Good luck..!

user_reviews.Name: Kirill Mikheyev
user_reviews.Description: Very good place. Nice food and spectacular ocean view

user_reviews.Name: Horace Michael
user_reviews.Description: A fun location to let loose in Dakar. The staff is cool. Different options of music and ambience. I visited twice and enjoyed myself both times.

user_reviews.Name: Faizal Raja
user_reviews.Description: Must try their grilled grouper.. yummy

user_reviews.Name: Marco Vacirca
user_reviews.Description:
Quite beautiful place, but for such a
" fancy-ish" place details should be important and for example they should not save money on speakers and toilet paper: The quality of the sound from the speakers is very poor and not clean at all. The toilets are not up to par for a stylish place and the toilet paper is guarded by the attendant, you realise it after you finish your business

user_reviews.Name: Lala Fofana
user_reviews.Description:
Last saturday, I went to this place with three of my associates after a recommendation. We wanted to relax and have drinks, so a lounge seemed perfect.
We made a call around 8pm and were told we could come. After finishing our first round, we decided to close the first tab with cash so one of us could put the next rounds on their card.
However, we were told by the server that we could not order anymore unless we bought a 200,000 fcfa bottle because they only allowed table service after 10pm because of a private party they were hosting. Again, we were not told any of this when we called. I went to talk to the manager (Peggy) to explain the situation, and she then apologized and told us to remain at our table and keep ordering.
As we went ahead with our second order, we were again told that we had to move because our table was reserved. Again, this was not disclosed to us when we were given the table. After many back and forth between the server, hostess, who told us this was a management order, I asked to see the manager once again as we could not understand why we were being harassed to move and refused drinks. The manager never showed up to our table. The hostess came once again to apologize for not telling us the table was reserved and should not have sat us there. In an effort to make all this easier for all,  we agreed to move to another table. We were brought to a section of the restaurant with high chairs and barely any room to sit, at which point my friends and I decided to leave. I went to the manager for a last word before leaving, to explain the terrible service we received, only after refusing to order an overpriced bottle. I explained once again that we were never told about reservations when we called HER and when we were sat, and how SHE told us that we could stay only to have her servers do the nasty job of compelling us to leave. She denied everything, after which three other men (a head server, another manager, and the owner who was also her husband), all came to her defense, denying our experience, justifying that they supported the decision to move us, and blaming the servers for all.
Now here’s the thing, at no point did the management team owned up to their own neglect and lack of communication with us. Even after telling me we could stay on our table, they still blamed the server (who was there when I spoke to management and who I talked to right after) for us being moved. The whole time we were waiting for our second round of drinks, we could see the manager talk to our waiters and the hostesses, who would then come back to us with some new issues and moving/ordering requests.
Having myself worked in the service industry, at all levels, I know from experience that a manager’s job is to at least be accommodating to their guests and explain THEMSELVES when there’s a service issue. It is easy to blame the wait staff and let them do the dirty job you don’t want to.
And let’s be clear here, there is no restaurant and definitely no manager without the PATRONS spending their money. The whole management team should be ashamed of themselves, you are a disgrace to the service industry. Because like the name says it, it is about SERVICE, you are not the stars. We spent over 60,000 fcfa and left with no apologies, no accountability, not even a compensatory drink (not that we needed any at that point). And by the way, 200,000 fcfa for cheap bottles is a scam that the stature of your establishment can’t justify. No one should go there, and as I’m sure there are many who have had an equally unpleasant experience, please people, write your reviews. You owe it to yourselves.

user_reviews.Name: Aida M. Ndiongue
user_reviews.Description: The lounge is neat and really nice. Prices are good and the food as well. Had dinner there on a Thursday night with the hubby and it was not crowded at all.

user_reviews.Name: Marika Antonino
user_reviews.Description:
My fiancé and I visited JetCafe on Tuesday, 18th November. The place was quite empty probably just because it was a Tuesday. Despite that, the food was amazing!! Everything was really fresh and flavorfulespecially the fish, which was excellent.

The only downside was the plantain it wasn’t fresh, was very hard, and it was reheated in the microwave. I really love plantain, so that was a bit disappointing.

The atmosphere was nice, with some music softly playing in the background. The service was a little slow, which was surprising given that it wasn’t busy.

The location is beautiful , you can enjoy a lovely view of the sea while dining. Overall, aside from the plantain and the slow service, everything else was great. I’ll definitely come back

user_reviews.Name: VASUNDHARA GHILDIYAL
user_reviews.Description: The atmosphere with the waves crashing around and the lounge music booming was an excellent experience 👌. The service was fast and the servers were very nice and welcoming. The food quantities and quality was amazing, would recommend 10/10 in every aspect.

user_reviews.Name: Rihab Kh
user_reviews.Description: I had brunch at Jet Cafe and it was delicious, with a great variety of food. The place is very clean, the staff are nice, well dressed, and well mannered. The view was amazing as well. I would definitely recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Tariro Mlanda
user_reviews.Description: Breathtaking atmosphere in white and fairy lights along the beach. What more can one want. The views are spectacular especially in the evening. Great service.  The food is very tasty and the portions are huge. However if you are not a fan of garlic, you might not enjoy the fish here for garlic is one of the main ingredients of their fish dishes. The atmosphere is still worth the visit though...

user_reviews.Name: Alex Adeiza
user_reviews.Description:
Jet Cafe Beach marked the very first outing of my 2-day stay in Dakar, Senegal. We went as a family and this place was just on point for us to neutralize the cold, eat and either watch the sun kiss the sea, or feets ride the ski.
The food was awesome - let’s keep it at that.
The service is where I had a bit of a problem because of language barrier. I had a bit of French to go by, but no staff could speak as much English as I did French. Well, Google translator helped a bit much.
The atmosphere was good. Light music, beautiful view, great white ambience with a glow of love all around to give that perfect picturesque. Nice nice 😊

user_reviews.Name: Hannah P
user_reviews.Description:
A beautiful restaurant overlooking the Atlantic Ocean! It was breezy, clean, and the staff were very friendly.

The menu is just a bit pricey, but understandable because the location and service were amazing! Would definitely recommend. :)

user_reviews.Name: Adam in Africa
user_reviews.Description: I had a nice dinner here: Fresh fish, with vegetables, rice, and a side salad, and a nice crepe with ice-cream for dessert. The service is great, you are right on the beach, and the restaurant has a nice atmosphere.

user_reviews.Name: Yeesh Rose
user_reviews.Description: Amazing views and great customer service. However food quality could have been better and the food could be hotter in temperature. The plantain was divine and freshly made though, yuummm!!

user_reviews.Name: Alice S
user_reviews.Description: Security guard let us past after some polite French conversation, he warned not more than 15 mins. Hopefully the site becomes public or at least the local community can clean it up and monetise it!

user_reviews.Name: Marion Zenlibrarian
user_reviews.Description: This beach and the point is closed to the public. A security guard will tell you it is private property. The buildings look deserted, and there is a building site with what looks like apartments in the making, again completely blocking off access to the most westerly point of Africa. Who allowed this to happen? :(

user_reviews.Name: Dragan Vidovic
user_reviews.Description: Closing off the Westernmost point of the Old World to the public is an act of barbarism. I hope their hotel will burn to the ground.

user_reviews.Name: Chris Joondeph
user_reviews.Description: This place is abandoned and closed. Security guard will stop you from going.

user_reviews.Name: Ndeye Fatou Ndiour
user_reviews.Description: Super

user_reviews.Name: Ghania Frédérique
user_reviews.Description:
Nous avons pu accéder à cette bel endroit propre
Le garde ne nous a rien demandé
Plage déserte, hôtel fermé mais la plage est belle , avec des coquillages

user_reviews.Name: Zac Ben Dhia
user_reviews.Description:
ATTENTION ⚠️ Le garde à l’entrée est une fraude, il demande 1000 cfa par personne pour rentrer. Ou plus si vous avez la tête de l’emploi :)
Vous passez tout simplement sans payer, la pointe est publique, l’hôtel n’existe plus et n’est pas en reconstruction. Passez et si il vous dit quelque chose vous dites appelez la police 😄

user_reviews.Name: Ines Roulet
user_reviews.Description: Ça pourrait être une magnifique plage… mais pleines de déchets (impossible de poser une serviette à un endroit sans déchet) …. Et baignade interdite

user_reviews.Name: Worldwide Reviewer
user_reviews.Description: Spent a peaceful day here. The beach is clean, the sand is soft and the surf school is available near by. Did not try much food here, but the pineapple ravioli dessert was mind blowing. Moroccan tea was also really nice. Enjoyed the tike spent here.

user_reviews.Name: Renevalle Kissila
user_reviews.Description: Great food! Modern cute decor! Although a few 86s! But will come back to try the grillades and the deserts! The bissap juice was not very sweet or minty and there was no music last night. The waitress was super friendly and accommodating! I recommend the Pavet boeuf which comes with the most delicious peppercorn sauce ever! Accompanied with sweet potato fires hmm salivating! ❤️

user_reviews.Name: Craig BTC
user_reviews.Description:
A rude woman greeted me, I asked if I could go in and see the restaurant I wanted to eat. She said no, I can’t look, I can’t walk through.
Looked at the menu, over priced.
No interest in paying for expensive food with rude staff!

user_reviews.Name: Tifani Dyson
user_reviews.Description:
Update: We went back for a Friday afternoon lunch. The restaurant was empty but the food came out very well. I’ve added updated photos.
.
The food was surprisingly good here. We had the local steak and gambas with sautéed vegetables. I would return for the food. They also offer beach chairs/umbrellas for rent, but the cost is 5000CFA per person, which is a bit steep, especially if you’re already buying food and drinks.

user_reviews.Name: Ginette Diallo
user_reviews.Description:
Beautiful spot near the beach where to chill with friends or family even if you have kids & dogs . Its super friendly. Their meals are just delicious . We tried the “moelleux coeur coulant” it was diviiiiine , if u like chocolate it’s THE dessert to choose .
Just enjoy & relaax ✨

user_reviews.Name: Abdoulaye CISSE
user_reviews.Description: The set up is great but the waiting time was aweful and it’s a bit pricy compared to the quantity of food they serve, shout out to server, he was nice.

user_reviews.Name: Jazmine Jazmine
user_reviews.Description:
It was a Hidden Gem as you feel that you are in another world with beautiful Beach view and the food is just out of this world
The seafood is so fresh and the presentation is amazing.
Thank you so much for the team and the Ghizlane the owner who was so welcoming and helpful as she helped us find logging and transport not expensive.
Thank you again

user_reviews.Name: Brandon Cole
user_reviews.Description: Food is good, but you pay an extreme amount for the food and then you also have to pay to walk through the gate to use the beach. For my family of 6 we paid more than 60,000 for food and had to pay 15,000 cfa to access a free beach. NOT WORTH THE MONEY.

user_reviews.Name: Kechna Toussaint
user_reviews.Description: Nice place pretty good view . If you love fish that’s where to go it won’t disappoint you.

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
Surfer Paradise has a great location right by the beach—spacious, beautifully decorated, and perfect for relaxing. Service is attentive and quick.

I ordered the fish burger but unfortunately within hours of eating it what followed was an intense bout of food poisoning that lasted over a week. It completely shifted the rhythm of my trip through Senegal, and not in a good way! While the staff checked in with me in the days after and showed genuine concern (which I deeply appreciated), the experience meant that I sadly cannot recommend the food here.

user_reviews.Name: The truth The truth
user_reviews.Description: Nice place to go chill relax the pool got sea water and they have a nice view facing the ocean and you can also surf there.

user_reviews.Name: Lois Seffu
user_reviews.Description: The location is amazing. The pool right along the waterfront is just heavenly. The place offers good vibes & a chill environment to meet people or kick it with friends. The food was fine and the had nice drink selection (even for those who don't imbibe). I will return here when I am back in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: Rahmat Sai Jimah
user_reviews.Description:
Their food was yummy and well spiced... The sea foods taste fresh and expertly prepared at reasonable prices compared to neighbouring restaurants.
Learn a little French to help you explain further if you're anglophone 🤣.

Their view at the sea side is lovely with a swimming pool. They have good locations for great photos

user_reviews.Name: Marley Barley
user_reviews.Description: I'm from Canada and we have a lot of different burgers however Surfers Paradise has the best burgers I've ever had oh my god the view as well and the service is just simply amazing Thank you all so much for such a wonderful stay! COME HERE!!

user_reviews.Name: Liz Hixon
user_reviews.Description:
Surfer Paradise is split level restaurant. The lower level was kind of like a nightclub with very loud music. Upper level was a nice patio on the beach. I felt the ambiance of the dining experience was compromised by the very loud music. At times, fog from the smoke machines drifted up which was unpleasant to breathe during dinner. I’m not sure if the nightclub vibe is every evening, but for nice dining, I would avoid if so.
The food was good, but not great. I ordered the thiof and it was okay. My friend ordered a steak bleu, but it was served à point.
Generally speaking, there are many restaurants along the corniche that are preferable to Surfer Paradise for an enjoyable dining experience and great food.

user_reviews.Name: Nomad USA
user_reviews.Description:
Meh 🫤. Slow service, warm beer, cold food.
The shrimp panne was good. Ordered the tagliatelle fruit de mere and the carbonara. Same cream sauce, usually the sea food tagliatelle comes with a red sauce. Tasted like a carbonara sauce. Shrimps were frozen and reheated. Didn’t taste fresh at all. There was no other seafood. Just the old shrimp. The carbonara. Was ok.  Didn’t see the bacon or ham in there.  Beer was warm. For Dakar it was all less than average.  Service was sloooooowwwww.

title: Petite Ngor Beach
address: QF2Q+5RH Petite Ngor Beach, Rue NG 179, Dakar, Senegal

user_reviews.Name: Mike & Brittnie Little
user_reviews.Description: Petite Ngor Beach is a decent spot, especially if you’re into water activities. The surfing off the coast near Ngor Island is excellent, and the waves attract plenty of surfers. We also went scuba diving, which was interesting and added to the experience. The beach itself is okay, but the real highlight is the ocean and the activities you can do here.

user_reviews.Name: Tomas Janik
user_reviews.Description: Super crowded beach, full of local people. And some other charge entrance fee (1000 F for foreigner…)… Interesting to see, but not usable for relax or similar beach things.

user_reviews.Name: Sara Della Santa
user_reviews.Description: Super nice little beach! All friendly people that wanna talk to you and help. From here you can take the pirogue to Ile de Ngor for 1000 cfa, in 5 minutes you’re on the island !

user_reviews.Name: Ivan Boljat
user_reviews.Description: Yes its not a super clean beach but cute cafes from the hotels and locals have a good time, lots of kids playing around. Especially during sunset it has a nice vibe to relax from the bustling city

user_reviews.Name: Alberto MAYNAR AGUILAR
user_reviews.Description: Very nice place to swim and enjoy lunch.

user_reviews.Name: Hendrik Vlaanderen
user_reviews.Description: Dirty and really pushy sales people. Not pleasant to visit, if you are looking for a relaxing place do not bother. Also not going for the island.

user_reviews.Name: Kátia Gomes
user_reviews.Description:
It's a potential place for tourism but it's full of trash. Trash on the sand, trash on the ocean, trash everywhere. It's a shame and the local population don't seem to care. It's common to see people eating and throwing plastic just right there. Every time I went there it was crowded also, therefore you might consider that if you are planning to go for peace and tranquility, you might not find it kkkk
The positive side is that it is always with people there, it looks safe, there is a nice view to the ngor island and there is always available transportation.

user_reviews.Name: Mario Nikita
user_reviews.Description: Very active public beach, with restaurants and groups of people doing exercise. Ferry going frequently to Ngor island. Good view of sunset

user_reviews.Name: runningdogyankee
user_reviews.Description: Seems like a nice place to hangout during the day for access to the ocean. We had drinks in the early evening and then left before the whole neighborhood descended into teenybopper party weekend and traffic jam nightmare.

user_reviews.Name: Nyota ya Africa
user_reviews.Description: If you spend time here, you can go swimming or serving. There are sunbeds, so you can relax before and after swimming! There is a shower inside the bathroom, so you can change into a swimsuit :) The food is so delicious and it's a great place to relax while looking at the sunny sky! The staff is nice, too!

user_reviews.Name: Alyssa Leggoe
user_reviews.Description: Food is always delicious here and the view can’t be beat! I gave them 4 stars because a bunch of menu items were out of stock - avocado, chicken - which made the menu less interesting.

user_reviews.Name: Aida Sall
user_reviews.Description: I am really sad that I’m writing this because this this part has been my favorite in a while. I’ve been coming to la plagr every single time I come over dakar since 2018 but recently the management has went to shit. The new waitresses are really, really rude. I had an incident where I accidentally broke my glass and I was met with such such rudeness when I’ve been A loyal client for years. I hope the owner sees this and takes care of the management because this spot the nicest. They have a really good chef. The food is exquisite. It’s just that the service has really really gone bad now which wasn’t the case before.

user_reviews.Name: Lydia Hickman
user_reviews.Description:
La Plage is one of my Dakar staples. It was my favorite restaurant for a while, but in recent times it’s become less consistent. Lately, they almost never have the full menu, which is quite annoying at times. Also, we’ve stopped getting the “planche Carnegie” because the kitchen just never cooks the meat medium rare no matter how much we insist (and we’ve insisted a TON). It’s always well done.

But I love that you can actually access the beach. There are other items that are quite tasty (pavé de capitaine, the ceviche with mangos, the bruschetta - when they have it - etc.) And the drinks are my fav in Dakar. Benjamin the barman is excellent and never disappoints, so I keep coming back!

user_reviews.Name: Tifani Dyson
user_reviews.Description: Good service and good food, including the steak and fish! Just be advised that the night menu and day menu are different. It would be 5 stars but the flies take away from the experience.

user_reviews.Name: Herman Du Plessis
user_reviews.Description: Nice little restaurant right on the coast, we had a work get together here, the food was great and the hosts very friendly.

user_reviews.Name: ouissam merbahi
user_reviews.Description: Nice place to hang out and spend very good quality time. Recommended

title: L'Adresse Dakar
description: Colourful rooms & suites in a chic hotel with an outdoor pool, a rooftop bar & a stylish restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: Brian Johnson
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely loved this hotel. The location in Almadies is perfect, and the building itself is beautiful — high ceilings, airy spaces, and a relaxed coastal feel.

The staff are exceptional, especially Anissa, who truly went above and beyond to help me arrange a driver to St. Louis and onward to The Gambia. That kind of personal care makes all the difference.

There’s a great rooftop bar, balconies in the rooms, and at night you can hear the ocean — which is pretty magical.

They even have a cat named Croissant, who I want to take with me. If you’re concerned about allergies, don’t be — the space is large and well-ventilated, so it’s not an issue.

Hard to ask for more from a hotel. I’d absolutely stay here again.

user_reviews.Name: timtraveler14
user_reviews.Description: I really loved my stay at L’Adresse.  The entire staff was so friendly.  Especially Thierry, the excellent server at the rooftop restaurant.  That restaurant was so nice, you can sit in the sun and look out over the ocean.  The airport shuttle was very nice.  And the hotel is close to a mosque and the Embassy of Guinea for onward travel.  The hotel is great!

user_reviews.Name: Matias Almang
user_reviews.Description:
I loved my stay at L’Adresse. The staff are very friendly and accommodating. They really make a great effort for your stay to be pleasant.

Even with my basic French, they were very patient and understanding. And they also spoke English.

The hotel has a nice rooftop bar, beautiful to enjoy the sunsets. The downstairs bar also offers nice drinks. The food is delicious!

The location is good, close to nice restaurants.

Thanks very much!

user_reviews.Name: lucifer796
user_reviews.Description: I want to say special thanks to Anissa J.M Seck who works reception. She is super professional, friendly, kind and understanding. She deserves a raise in salary. Other than that, personnel is friendly and professional. Why i can’t give the 5 stars is because personnel working the restaurant is completely clueless what infredients are in the food, which can cause fatal accidents if person is allergic to seafood etc. Because we had an instance where my companion ordered vegetarian food yet they brought seafood option and waiter argued that it’s vegetables and went twice to the kitchen to ask the chef where chef just confirmed its vegetarian option. After some arguing, the waiter agreed to take the food to the kitchen and informed that the correct order is coming (not admitting the mistake). Next time it happend on next day during breakfast when me companion asked if spring rolls contain meat to which waiter said no, that its vegetarian, which was also completely false. So get that together please. Rooms are spacious and clean. Cleaning staff do the great job upkeep the place in cleanliness. There is parking outside the hotel with 24/7 security. Overall great place, but just educate staff and kitchen to take orders and allergens seriously.

user_reviews.Name: Vanessa Cheris
user_reviews.Description:
THE GOOD
Room was spacious. It’s a newly built hotel so everything is clean and relatively modern, albeit simple

The Senegalese food at the rooftop bar was fantastic. The tieb rice was on point and fish, wonderful. We also had the beef skewers and plantains but get the traditional meals. The waiter didn’t understand our order and gave us double the amount of meals we asked for instead of a side, so they over-charged but it tasted great, and it was nice ambiance up there.

THE BAD
The room is missing basic amenities - towels! We had 2 ppl in the room and they refused to bring us enough towels. I called  and went down to reception twice and they still did nothing. No wash cloths, No lotion. They charge close to Pullman prices, but have significantly less amenities

Hotel is solid but should cost closer to 150 USD for what you get, not over 200 USD

user_reviews.Name: Worldwide Reviewer
user_reviews.Description:
I rarely write negative reviews, but my experience at L’dresse Hotel was frustrating enough to warrant one.

Unhelpful staff: The reception staff showed little interest in improving our stay. For two days we were promised that our room change would happen “tomorrow,” yet nothing was done until we insisted repeatedly.

Basic amenities neglected: We had to ask daily for toilet paper and water bottles because room service failed to provide them. For half of our 8‑night stay, we lived with only one towel set, and our requests for additional towels were ignored.

Cockroach problem: Our first room (404) had six cockroaches the moment we opened the door. After moving to room 210, we still encountered three more over the next six days.

Poor room conditions: Rooms smelled of mold and moisture, showers were rusty, and noise isolation was terrible.

Breakfast disappointment: The food selection was minimal and of low quality, far below expectations for a hotel stay.

Confusing hotel name: Even getting to the hotel was a struggle. The name “L’dresse” confused many French‑speaking taxi drivers, and we had to explain the address multiple times before being understood.

Individually, these issues might be tolerable, but combined they created an environment that was uncomfortable and unsuitable for a business trip—especially a longer one. L’dresse Hotel failed to provide even the basics of hospitality, and I cannot recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Иван Ильин
user_reviews.Description: I had a good stay — the staff were very friendly and helpful, the food was great, and the atmosphere was pleasant. The room was okay, comfortable but could use a bit of improvement. Overall, a nice place to stay in

user_reviews.Name: Lana amir
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed for a week and enjoyed my time there. The staff is really friendly and helpful. The cleaning service is good. The food in the restaurant is also good.

I recommend the administration to provide slippers and 2 water bottles per day :)

user_reviews.Name: Capricorn Sundae
user_reviews.Description: Food was delicious and fresh. We ordered the wings as an appetizer (great choice). For the entree, I ordered the club sandwich. It was very tasty, made with fresh ingredients. Honestly everything was really good, I would visit again if i didn’t live in another country.

user_reviews.Name: Francine Nkongo
user_reviews.Description:
Very tasty food! I am not a fan of fish however this meal was very tasty. I would recommend. We went during the day and had a great choice of seating.

The restaurant is tucked away next to Jungle and the paddle/tennis courts.

user_reviews.Name: Ro Law
user_reviews.Description: Hotel staff recommended this spot. I didn't realize it was right on the water but I loved it. The waitress was super kind and patient as I don't speak French. The grilled shrimp was delicious and the dj's music made it a vibe! 💃🏾

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
Le Carré is a bit tricky to find—you’ll need to head toward Rocca Marina and go behind the football pitches to get there. Once inside, the setting is beautiful: comfy sofas, a sea view, and a perfect spot to watch the surfers off to the left. The hostesses were welcoming, and the space itself is nicely designed.

That said, the music was louder than I’d like and didn’t quite match the relaxing coastal vibe—it felt more like a lounge trying to push a shisha bar atmosphere, which clashed with the setting for me.

The menu was a bit limited during my visit. I came in hoping for fresh fish, especially being right by the sea, but they didn’t have what I wanted available and suggested meat instead, which wasn’t quite what I was after.

Nice spot to chill and have drinks.

user_reviews.Name: Fab E
user_reviews.Description: Was a bit tricky to find but nice location in general. We were seated directly and didn't wait. That was for the positive side. The music was loud, while ordering our food, the waitress told us that the fish was fresh and it was written grilled on the menu, but once the food arrived we were disappointed. The food was cold, the fish wasn't fresh and the chicken dry. The only good point was the ginger juice. We do not recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Alex F
user_reviews.Description:
I really enjoyed the evening at Le Carré Dakar, I came here for dinner alone. From the beginning the staff were welcoming and very friendly.

The interior is semi-outside, and if you can get the seats by the water it’s amazing, the waves just beneath - there are also lounges right above the waves if you wish.

I heard the cocktails are great here, so I tried a few flavored mojitos and they did not disappoint - watch out they are quite strong.

I had Dorade Braisée and that was probably the best fish dish I have ever had! The flavours were incredible, it was cooked to perfection and Aloco as a side just made it all come together. It’s a must try!

Restaurant has a nice vibe, there’s music so it’s a bit of a restaurant lounge place, imagine it gets a bit wilder later in the night. It was busy with locals and tourists - don’t miss it if you’re in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: Khady Graydon
user_reviews.Description: There was construction happening - very loud and upsetting me and my guests. I couldn’t even speak when someone was right next to me. I’m not sure why they wanted to fix whatever they were doing while the guest were here but it was way too loud and not relaxing at all. We were with kids and they started to cry from how loud the noise was.

user_reviews.Name: Se Ku
user_reviews.Description: A little on the pricier end, but it's a nice little place with good music if you are looking to wind with a nice view. The food is also quite good. I had the pepper steak, it was tender and cooked perfectly. As for the cocktails, you can ask for the mango passion fruit (it's not on the menu), but compliments to the bartender and waitress for suggesting it.

user_reviews.Name: Nirmallya Das
user_reviews.Description: Nice place to visit, good atmosphere, nice food, resenble price. Good crowd

user_reviews.Name: Dibej Vlogs The YouTuber
user_reviews.Description: Great place good vibes, especially if u're single

user_reviews.Name: Diane Bryant
user_reviews.Description: I had a blast. I was in Senegal for a week and was there the whole week up until it was time for me to take my Yango to take me to the airport. I’ll be 40 in two years. I think I may have my 40th there. I just have to get my friends in America to get their passports

user_reviews.Name: Sokhna Fall
user_reviews.Description: Thèse are the best restaurants White à great atmosphere I recommend you go and discover them  but they are not suitable for children

user_reviews.Name: aly haidara
user_reviews.Description: I am really shocked today about the conduct of one of the waitresses! She was very disrespectful for no reason at all! I can’t work hard to earn my money and spend it where I am not respected!!

user_reviews.Name: Ucman S
user_reviews.Description: I went in for a takeaway for Yassa chicken which si the most common dish in Senegal, the portion of rice was shockingly small, the sauce full of Olives (why?) and pretty tasteless. For 7500 CFA, it was definitely not worth it especially after a 45 minutes wait.

user_reviews.Name: Caleb Brumley
user_reviews.Description: The staff and the drinks were as enjoyable and refreshing as the cool sea breeze at Yoff Beach. If the prices were a bit lower this would be five-stars all the way.

user_reviews.Name: Coya Albert
user_reviews.Description: Not bad a place too go if you single and want to spend money …

user_reviews.Name: Jean and Martin Choi
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful outdoor space to enjoy the ocean and delicious food. The drinks and dishes were all well prepared. Though the price is a bit high, the taste was great. Customer service was great. Atmosphere was great. We were also offered handmade chocolate morsels on our way out.

user_reviews.Name: Ranjeeta Sharma
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful ocean facing view. Mesmerizing and enchanting especially if you plan to have an early breakfast or brunch. The staff is well trained and polite. Food was ok we'd brunch. Drinks were mediocre and could improve those for sure. They over charge for a 500 ml water bottle though. Would recommend specially for the great view and vibe.

user_reviews.Name: Capricorn Sundae
user_reviews.Description: This was my first time visiting the country and this was hands down the best restaurant I’ve experienced while touring. The food is absolutely fantastic. The view is phenomenal and our servers were polite and kind. I truly enjoyed myself, 100% recommend!!

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
Le Cabanon is hands-down my go-to place in Dakar. I come here 3–4 times a week to watch the waves, the surfers, and the sunset—it’s just a beautiful, comfortable and relaxing spot.

The food is great—especially the pain perdu (French toast), which is an absolute must-try. Everything is served fresh and with care.

The staff are always warm and welcoming, and there’s always someone nearby if you need anything. Compared to other restaurants along the coast, Le Cabanon stands out as the best by far.

I also love the little detail of being offered a chocolate at the till when you leave—it’s a sweet, thoughtful touch that wraps up the experience perfectly and always makes me smile.

If you’re into art, you’ll definitely appreciate the unique decor and creative atmosphere.

Thank you for Le Cabanon!

user_reviews.Name: Aijan K
user_reviews.Description: The view is beautiful, especially if you catch the sunset. Interior is also very nice. We ordered muscles. They were is this tomato sauce, not what I’m used to in US. Drinks can be too sweet, but I’ll go for the view again.

user_reviews.Name: Lucky Abraham
user_reviews.Description:
Had a nice time at Le Cabanon. There is a nice chilled view of the Atlantic with good musical vibes. Recommended for individuals or groups.

The waiters can do better in their service.

user_reviews.Name: Jan
user_reviews.Description:
This restaurant is definitely a place to go if you like to take photos of you and the surrounding and the food.

I went with a party of 5 total for brunch on a Friday morning. It was surprisingly not busy during this hour. We sat out by the ocean and it was great vibes.

What was initially confusing was the way the brunch menu selection worked. The first four of us were given two brunch selection total where we had to fill out for two people on one. This could be done better with an indicator where it’s being selected for 1 or 2 persons.

The food was decently good and decent amount of food as well. That was nice. I ended up being full and enjoyed that I could eat most of what I ordered.

Overall, service was great. I liked that. Bathrooms were clean, I assume this is managed by a non-Senegalese or someone who knows their stuff about running a business catering to tourists and foreigners who look for comfort and luxury while in Senegal.
Just like their ‘In Regards To” statement on their website, “Le Cabanon is an experience where pleasure, sharing and indulgence come together” … they have that down to the tea.

user_reviews.Name: Lulu B
user_reviews.Description:
Really nice location by the sea and the staff were super attentive and friendly!

However, if I lived in Dakar this would turn into the spot I’d visit for a couple of drinks instead because it’s super pricey and I’d struggle to see the value if I visited for food. I was shocked the bill came to the same average price as a high end restaurant in London!!

user_reviews.Name: Noreen Dove
user_reviews.Description: I stayed at Boma Hotel and had the most amazing experience. The hotel is absolutely beautiful and truly feels like an oasis. What made our stay especially memorable, however, was the incredible staff, who went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed for a comfortable and enjoyable visit. Thank you as well for the lovely birthday cake — such a thoughtful touch. I highly recommend this hotel, with a special shout-out to Aboudou for his outstanding hospitality. We will miss you all!

user_reviews.Name: D784VMbevb
user_reviews.Description: Very well located , plush surroundings , the room was welcoming and with a net around the bed gave a very luxurious feel. Some very personal touches in toiletries and complimentary slippers just made the experience unique. Would visit again and recommend this hotel . Therese and Abdou were very friendly . Thank you

user_reviews.Name: Trip.com Member
user_reviews.Description: The staff were very attentive, friendly and helpful.Great food and happy-hour cocktails! Would definitely recommend it. Great location.

user_reviews.Name: Sophie Adams
user_reviews.Description: Everything about BOMA is wonderful, we extended our stay. A peaceful and beautiful oasis. The staff?? Amazing!!  They were super helpful all through our stay which made it easy. I’ll go back again and again.

user_reviews.Name: taylerh2013
user_reviews.Description: Lovely place to stay. Conveniently located in popular area for lounges/restaurant/clubs in Almadies. Food, drinks & entertainment were all very good. Would stay here again, in my honest opinion the costs are premium and no one came to clean my room my entire stay of 3 nights.

user_reviews.Name: Grace
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been to Boma several times and each time better than the last. Today was no different! The cheese burger is my go to but the vegan mafe is phenomenal. In fact the food and drinks are always amazing and the staff is fantastic. Highly recommend for lunch dinner or drinks if you like nice positive vibes and a pool side atmosphere.

user_reviews.Name: rachelbX8942LN
user_reviews.Description: This was a perfect stay for first time visitors to Dakar and Senegal. We were scuba diving and surfing in Ngor, so we could walk from the hotel (although its better to drive after dark). Very comfortable rooms, nice restaurant. The staff was exceptional

user_reviews.Name: Chinwe Okorafor
user_reviews.Description: Disappointing - Hotel rooms need maintenance and thorough cleaning. My room has corners and surfaces that seem as though no one had cleaned it in days. I visited this hotel in 2021 and loved my experience - impeccably tidy rooms, beautiful decor, and service was excellent. Now over 4 years later, a lot has changed. I was shown to a room that had visible signs of wear/tear. The initial room I was given has bugs and cobwebs surrounding the patio door, water marks/dark stains at the bathroom doorway and a bucket in the bathroom to catch leaking water. I declined that room and was assigned another with less issues but still had poor cleaning standards. Aside from the pool, restaurant, front desk staff and location, I can’t recommend staying here until they complete an overhaul in maintenance work and improve room cleanliness.

user_reviews.Name: ousseynou gueye
user_reviews.Description: Très bon service avec des plats agréables , délicieux et sains

user_reviews.Name: Lucie Valot
user_reviews.Description: Intime et très jolie plage sur la corniche de Dakar. L’eau est magnifique et les gardes plage très sympas.

user_reviews.Name: Marieme Diallo
user_reviews.Description: Plage propre

user_reviews.Name: Ady Bouare
user_reviews.Description: Lieux magnifique.

user_reviews.Name: Angele MESSA
user_reviews.Description: Calm and beautiful space for a cozy and beautiful moment. Took my dad out for dinner at sunset. He loved it. I went for the paella and it was really good and the strong waves was like song in our ears. Try the fondant as dessert

user_reviews.Name: Empress Carter
user_reviews.Description: This is a beautiful restaurant. Great location. Gorgeous scenery. Hospitable service. Great food. This is where I experienced Senegalese Téranga hospitality and authentic Senegalese food. I highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Leah
user_reviews.Description: Lovely spot on the water. The food was fresh and the menu was diverse. I had the chef special which was a fun local dish and my friend had a fish sandwich which she said was fine. The breeze off the ocean was lovely.

user_reviews.Name: Katy Wheelock
user_reviews.Description: I've been bringing groups of up to 20 Americans and Canadians here for dinner. It's a beautiful view at night of the Monument de la Renaissance and the Phare, We work with the restaurant in advance to create a menu that meets the dietary needs and restrictions of the group. Usually they give us too much food! But it is tasty and appreciated. It is lovely dining with the sound of waves crashing right next to the restuarant.

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
I came to Chez Fatou hoping to try the thieboudienne, but they didn’t have it that day. I went with the staff’s recommendation of thiof instead—and it was absolutely delicious. Generous portion, the fish was full of flavour and so satisfying I couldn’t finish it. Took the rest home and enjoyed it again the next day!

The atmosphere was quiet and peaceful, with soft music playing in the background—perfect for a relaxing dinner by the sea. The service was attentive, and while it’s on the pricier side, the quality of the experience made it feel worth it.

user_reviews.Name: giulio galante
user_reviews.Description: Nice view on the shore. A part this the food is ok but not spectacular, staff was kind but had to ask the supervisor any simple question (like what kind of wine do you serve by glass) and they didn’t accept credit or debit cards just cash or mobile money

user_reviews.Name: Miguel Benjamin Bityeki Mbamba
user_reviews.Description:
Food is really good. Service is quick and well done. Price is also good considering the quality of the meal, Service, location, etc.
Really nice spot for a good lunch or dinner with friends, family or colleagues.

user_reviews.Name: Esayas Girmay
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful place in Almadie right at the corniche beach. Good choice of food, not very tasty though. We had grillee fish and beef fillet. The atmosphere is tranquille. Would go again.

user_reviews.Name: Julie Willey
user_reviews.Description: Really pleasant experience. I speak very little french and the staff was helpful and tried to accommodate me. Nice very, nice weather, good music.

user_reviews.Name: ovey yeung 楊傲斐
user_reviews.Description: Loved being able to eat and tan and dip myself in the pool. The bathroom is limited and no change room so it’s best if you change at home and come. There’s a shower outside. One bathroom for ladies and one bathroom for men shared in a common area with no door.

user_reviews.Name: David Walker
user_reviews.Description: This place has always been a really nice little spot on Viviers Beach. They recently renovated and now it is a bit more of a classy spot but it still has a nice relaxed feel. The food is excellent. The service is fairly relaxed but friendly.

user_reviews.Name: Inês João
user_reviews.Description: Nice beach club with good food and great views. There are also chairs by the beach you can lay down and enjoy the view and surfers. Good to spend one full day! Prices are ok, however you can only pay with cash. Waitresses are nice and waiting time is good.  They also feature a small swimmingpool but you have to pay to use. Direct access to a small rocky beach.

user_reviews.Name: Mihanta Rak
user_reviews.Description:
Best place for kids and family time in Almadies.
The pool is little but children can play there alone. A very good lifeguard who keeps eyes on kids.
Staff are very cool and there is a playground too.
Food is good as well. For cocktail lover, mojito is good there 😋
We recommend of course 👌

user_reviews.Name: sam kaasjong
user_reviews.Description: The food was good taste but when you go to your hotel you wil Find out something wasn’t right….

user_reviews.Name: Kharmencita Bridges
user_reviews.Description: Nice place to experience the sunset view and where the young surfers enjoying there water activities and of course excellent foods too😍.

user_reviews.Name: Ernesto A
user_reviews.Description: Food was great. Service was decent. The views spectacular. Nice place to visit.

title: Snack and Surf
address: A côté Quiksilver, Cor des Almadies, Dakar, Senegal

complete_address.street: A côté Quiksilver, Cor des Almadies

user_reviews.Name: Nina B
user_reviews.Description:
New spot in Almadies, perfect for after-surf or after-sport snack, a coffee break, or sweet or savory quick and fresh meal.
Charming ambiance, with an indoor space and terrace among trees, and strong wifi.
Notice the new spot by the beautiful wall mural🌊

user_reviews.Name: Viggo Westh Said
user_reviews.Description:
Agréable terrasse en hauteur ventilée et cosy,
Prix tout à fait raisonnables, nouveaux concepts et surtout une superbe équipe sur place !

Loman Art in Dakar is a unique guesthouse that blends art, comfort, and Senegalese hospitality.

And there is always something happening: art exhibition, yoga class by the pool, theme nights food on the rooftop bar etc..  We loved it, it is a peaceful place to stay in Dakar and meeting Loman is also something. She is amazingly interesting and a passionate person with a very big heart and very talented too. We loved her work, so much that we brought back home a piece of her art. If you are looking for the human element of travel, a meaningful interaction, this is the place to stay in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: Alexandra Thomas
user_reviews.Description:
Loman Art Villa feels less like a guesthouse and more like a living archive. Metalwork flashes in the Sahel light, and the walls carry the marks of time. The space is arranged for more than rest, it stages encounters: conversations lingering by the pool, fabrics and laughter carried on the rooftop breeze. Each room reads like a small essay in repair and reuse, with welded reliefs, carved stools, and plants quietly curating their own corners.

Hospitality here is not a service but a method. Artists, travelers, and neighbors gather into a temporary commons where workshops and shared meals blur exhibition with everyday life. The villa’s architecture looks both to the Atlantic and to Dakar’s restless vernacular, refusing the sealed white cube in favor of porous thresholds and convivial improvisation. You arrive as a visitor and soon realize you’re already implicated: in the city’s creative ecologies, in the economies of care that sustain them, in the soft infrastructures that make art a daily, collective habit.

user_reviews.Name: Niclas Ericsson
user_reviews.Description:
This place is well located, right in the middle of Ngor beach. It's the perfect place to people watch for a tourist. You will have all the local people, villagers, fishermen, youths playing sports, and you can watch the boats leaving for the beautiful island of Ngor. Also seems to be a bit of a hangout for the young, trendy urban crowd of this city. The furniture and style are modern and kind of "night-club stylish". Food is above average for Dakar, but at the same time, it is not spectacular. They have dishes that will suit tourists, for sure, and they are as expected. They have crêpes with cheese and ham for 4000, and they are tasty. Prices are normal for a place that is a little bit upscale, 3000-8000 for a meal.
Service is friendly and correct, but also slow and unprofessional. Slow service and low knowledge of French or English is not unusual in this region, so it's not necessarily worse than any average place, but far from top-notch.
I must point out, as this is on the beach, that I have on many occasions left all my stuff and gone swimming or just strolling the beach. You ask the security guy to keep a close eye on your stuff, and when you leave, you give a special tip just for him (cash in his hand). I usually give 1000 cfa, so it's about 2 usd/1,5 euro. He totally appreciates, and I have never had any problems and felt totally safe. This is a huge plus for me, as I usually travel alone. Big kudos to their security guys! I will always come back because it's a place where I can leave my stuff and feel safe, and enjoy the beach and the sea.

user_reviews.Description: I stayed at King Fahad Hotel as one of the Brussels passengers whose flight was cancelled. These were not hotel items, and we did not eat them inside the restaurant. Later at lunch, someone who had breakfast with me mentioned that the manager had accused me of taking hotel food. She had already explained to him that nothing was taken, but she suggested I clarify with him directly.||When I approached him calmly to clear up the misunderstanding, he immediately became defensive and visibly angry. Instead of listening, he raised his voice, accused me of being rude, and questioned why I would “bring this up in front of his employees.” I tried several times to explain that the food was not from the hotel and that it was only brought for the road because we didn’t know our departure time.||His behaviour escalated quickly. He said to me, “Do you know who I am?”, which felt unnecessarily intimidating. He continued speaking aggressively while staff and guests watched. Some bystanders even stepped in, telling him that the way he was speaking to me was inappropriate.||I told him that I approached him only to resolve the issue, but now felt embarrassed and uncomfortable. When I asked him to please walk away so the situation could de-escalate, he refused. My entire table left the restaurant because it felt unsafe to remain there.||When we walked out, he followed us outside, despite me already expressing that his behaviour made me feel intimidated. All of this occurred openly in the restaurant and should be visible on CCTV if reviewed.||Afterward, several hotel employees privately approached me to apologise, saying things like “he can be that way” and “he is always like this, he is the hotel manager.” While I appreciated their kindness, it was concerning that this behaviour seems to be known and tolerated within the hotel.||This experience overshadowed what could have been a comfortable stay. No guest — especially a woman travelling with a child during an already stressful flight cancellation — should feel unsafe, shouted at, or intimidated by a hotel manager.||I sincerely hope senior management investigates this incident and ensures that no guest is treated this way in the future. The rest of the staff tried their best, but this behaviour from the manager was unacceptable and deeply unprofessional.

user_reviews.Description: The service is quite good! The mint tea is plentiful, especially to keep you warm, and the shisha flavours are abundant. Although I would have preferred a different design with lights and walls, this lounge is still pretty good overall!

user_reviews.Name: Serhii
user_reviews.Description:
We were looking for a place to smoke shisha – it’s quite hard to find a decent spot in Amsterdam, so we decided to give this one a try. The hookah looked good and modern, definitely not cheap Egyptian plastic.

The Al Fakher tobacco isn’t great – they could try better brands like Dark Side or Fumari – but I won’t blame them, as I knew before coming that they only use Al Fakher. The shisha itself was quite good.

The place is very smoky – it seems like there’s no proper ventilation, or it’s not working well. If you’re not used to sitting in such smoky environments, it might be uncomfortable. The restroom was quite clean. We didn’t order food, so I can’t comment on that. Overall, there aren’t many options for shisha in Amsterdam, so this place wasn’t bad.

user_reviews.Name: Maryam
user_reviews.Description: Enjoyed my two visits to this lounge. The prices are good but they should definitely have special pricing for ladies since large majority of the guests are men. user_reviews.Description:
This is one of my favourite coffee shops! The white widow pre rolls are very good!

I would advise people though to make sure the lovely chap serving watches you put the money in the machine (if paying by cash of course!). I fed €22 in for my wonderful products (10/10) which totalled €21.50, got 50c change and put it in the tip char! There was then some confusion over whether I’d paid or not and if it was 50c short 🤔 so, after a phone call etc I paid the 50c to resolve the problem!

So
, not to be put off by this review because it is a wonderful place with very friendly staff! I will be returning for definite 👌🏻
Hope things tallied up that night because I definitely paid!

user_reviews.Name: Aakash
user_reviews.Description:
Came on Sunday and called in advance to confirm pricing was cheaper compared to local options and that they accepted card. Made the long commute to find out they require drink purchases for every person which brings it to be more expensive than local options. Conveniently never mentioned this when speaking on the phone. The pack isn’t bad but it’s not great either. Does a decent job on replacing coals. When paying told me they don’t accept card and to go to an ATM. After venting my frustration that I confirmed this wasn’t true with him prior, he suddenly had a card reader available. This situation paired with the fact that I had gone out of my way for cheaper prices and ended up paying more left me feeling dissatisfied with the whole experience.

Edit: Changing review from 2 stars to 1 stars. I confirmed in person as well as over the phone about taking card. There was no one else who checked out in the time that I was there for a problem to have manifested in the card reader. The card reader worked perfectly fine when I used it and you never brought it up that there was an issue with the card reader when you suddenly pulled it out once I started complaining in front of other customers. I don’t appreciate the misinformation or skewing of the story.

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Georgiev
user_reviews.Description:
At first, when we walked by, we thought it looked like a pretty sketchy place, but we decided to give it a try — and it turned out to be a very good experience. We paid €20 for a shisha mix called Love 66. It wasn’t excellent, but definitely decent and worth the price (I’ve had much worse before, and I’m used to higher standards).

We also ordered Chivas with Coca-Cola for €10, which I felt was a fair price for what we got. The man working there was very friendly, attentive, and changed our coals often, which I really appreciated.

Since there aren’t many shisha spots in Amsterdam, I’d say you can’t go wrong with this place — just don’t judge it by how it looks from the outside. Plus, they had some really nice R&B music playing, which added to the vibe.

user_reviews.Description:
This was a fantastic experience, I was last minute  trying to organise a surprise for my sister’s 30th Birthday and despite no boats being available Radi managed to organise a private tour on the date & time we needed!! She was also so helpful throughout the rest of the process!

When we got there the boat was nice and chilled just as advertised. Radi was an exceptional host, super knowledgeable, friendly and funny, complimenting our group perfectly.

Tyler our captain was also amazing! Equally as friendly and very impressive on the water.

These two ladies made our trip unforgettable and I could not recommend this experience enough 🙌

user_reviews.Description: Had a lovely snowy canal cruise last weekend. The price was value for money, warm boat and welcome knowledgeable staff, our boat had a small toilet which was a bonus, smoke friendly. Tea cofee and drinks and snacks available to buy. Lovely vibe especially in a little snow flurry. Would recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Michael G Hannon
user_reviews.Description: Tyler our Captain was incredible.  very friendly, chatty and helped us get the best photos/ and videos possible. Our hosts name escapes my mind but he was also great!  We went on a night time cruise and brought our bong on board. Will definitely be back again, Hopefully with the same crew! Hope the Weather's good for your friends Holiday Tyler!

user_reviews.Name: Madison Marino
user_reviews.Description:
What an amazing experience! My partner and I discovered this trip through some travel bloggers on TikTok, and it absolutely lived up to the hype. The boarding point was super convenient - just a short few minutes walk from the tram stop at Centraal Station. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and very knowledgeable about the area.

During the cruise, we passed several iconic sights, including the famous Seven Bridges - a perfect spot for photos. Drinks are available for purchase on board (both alcoholic and non-alcoholic), and you’re also welcome to bring your own 🍃 to enjoy while you sail.

My partner and I had such a great time; it was definitely one of the highlights of our trip. We highly recommend the Buddha Smoke Boat to anyone 18+ and able-bodied looking for a fun, laid-back experience in Amsterdam!

user_reviews.Name: jade byrne
user_reviews.Description: The best boat cruise I have ever done in Amsterdam! Excellent vibe, exceptional staff! Shout out to Radi and Jarmo for an amazing evening. If I could give more than 5 stars - it would be absolutely well deserved!! Keep up the great work!!

The atmosphere was incredibly relaxing, and everything was well organized. It was the perfect way to unwind and enjoy the day. Highly recommended, and I’m already looking forward to coming back next year!

user_reviews.Name: Steve McConnell
